MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 32

3. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 44
   C. 30
   D. 22

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

6. Solve for x: x + 7 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 16
   C. 9
   D. 7

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 15

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 23
   C. 19
   D. 17

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 77
   D. 22

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 37
   D. 2

17. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

18. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 13
   C. 40
   D. 41

19. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 1

20. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 50

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

24. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
